_sources.Proj_O: max(AstraSim compute, max(roofline compute_ns/util, roofline memory_ns))

metadata.utilization_model: compute_ns / gpu_utilization per module; proj_qkv/proj_o indexed by batch_size; score/attn_v indexed by effective_seq=cache_seq*dk/dk_ref
metadata.rubin_utilization_model: H100 HBM BW utilization from e2e profiling; applied to Rubin roofline total_ns as total_ns / bw_util
metadata.rubin_tp2_model: Rubin TP1 roofline / 2 per GPU, H100 TP2 BW util, NVLink roofline AR (bw=1.8TB/s, lat=900ns, msg=4096B)
metadata.h100_tp2_model: H100 TP1 roofline / 2 per GPU, H100 TP2 BW util, H100 NVLink AR (bw=0.9TB/s, lat=900ns, msg=4096B)
